name: cavemio-model-picker
title: Model picker
description: The model pill in your composer grows into the menu: what each model is for, speed, smarts and thinking effort.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Put it beside Send with align="end": the model is a setting on how the message goes out, and the panel then lines up with the composer’s right edge.
- The pill is a button with aria-haspopup="listbox"; the list takes focus when open, and the active row is announced through aria-activedescendant.
- Arrow keys, Home and End move; Enter or Space picks; Escape closes and returns focus to the pill. Tab reaches the Thinking control, a radio group you move through with the arrow keys.
- Meters have text for screen readers ("Speed 2 of 3"), so they don’t rely on the dots alone.
- Always check the model id on the server; the picker only offers choices.
- Installs Text morph. With reduced motion, it opens, closes and changes its label instantly.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: models
props.type: { id; name; description?; icon?; speed?; intelligence?; reasoning?; locked? }[]
props.description: – · speed and intelligence are 1 to 3. reasoning adds the Thinking control; locked shows "Pro".

props.name: effort / onEffortChange
props.description: – · Thinking effort for reasoning models; the control appears when onEffortChange is set.

props.name: onLockedSelect
props.description: – · Called instead of selecting a locked model. Without it, locked models are disabled.

props.name: side / align
props.description: "top" / "start" · Grow upward or downward, from the pill’s left or right edge.

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: – · Open clear of this element, e.g. your composer, lined up with its edge, instead of over it. Without it, the panel opens just above the pill.

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: 16 · Space kept from the screen edges. On narrow screens the panel narrows and shifts to stay fully visible.

features.title: The pill shows model and effort
features.description: The model name and effort morph when they change, for example “Medium” to “High”.

features.title: What each model is for
features.description: Each model has a line of description and small speed and smarts meters, with text for screen readers.

features.title: Thinking effort
features.description: Reasoning models add a Low, Medium, High control. Pass your own levels.

features.title: Pro models stay visible
features.description: Locked models show “Pro”, and choosing one calls onLockedSelect instead of switching.

features.title: It opens clear of your prompt
features.description: With anchorRef the panel opens above the composer without covering it, and on narrow screens it narrows and shifts to stay in view.

features.title: Keyboard friendly
features.description: Arrow keys, Home and End move, Enter picks and Escape closes and returns focus to the pill.

states.title: closed
states.description: A quiet pill: icon, model name, and the effort for reasoning models, e.g. "Aurora Think Medium". A new model or effort morphs in place ("Medium" → "High"); the effort opens or folds over 380ms as reasoning comes and goes.

states.title: open
states.description: The pill lifts clear of the composer and grows into a 340px panel above it, lined up with its edge. The current model is checked and a highlight slides with the pointer or arrow keys.

states.title: effort
states.description: For reasoning models, a Thinking control (Low, Medium, High) with a sliding thumb. The panel grows to fit it.

states.title: locked
states.description: "Pro" instead of a check. Choosing it calls onLockedSelect, e.g. to open pricing, and keeps the current model.

states.title: closing
states.description: The panel folds back into the pill; focus returns to it.
